# Admission v3 conformance corpus

`corpus.json` is the language-neutral verification corpus for the
`zone-admission-lease/3` contract. Every vector carries one complete
verification input (exact envelope bytes, the expected signer URI, the
trust bundle, the revocation set and the decision clock) plus the
reference verdict and bounded refusal class produced by the Go reference
pipeline (`wire/internal/conformance`).

Every implementation of the v3 verifier, in any language, must produce the
same accept or refuse verdict for every vector. Refusal classes map to each
implementation's own refusal taxonomy; the mapping must be total and
documented by that implementation.

Classes: `unsupported_contract`, `malformed`, `non_canonical`,
`not_yet_valid`, `expired`, `signer_profile`, `signer_validity`,
`untrusted_signer`, `revoked_signer`, `lease_outside_signer`, `signature`.

`signer_validity` is unreachable through the reference evaluation order
(payload time judgments run first, and lease times are bounded by signer
times), so no vector carries it; the check exists as defense in depth for
implementations that judge the signer before the payload.

The corpus is generated by `wire/internal/admissioncorpusgen`, which
evaluates every vector against the reference pipeline before writing it,
and is committed. All identities and infrastructure names in it are
synthetic, and the fixture keys are ephemeral test keys discarded at
generation, so regenerating produces different bytes. `corpus.sha256`
pins the exact content. A change to any vector's verdict or refusal class
is a change to the wire contract; regenerate the corpus only deliberately,
and only together with such a change.
